final: WITH g AS (SELECT arcref AS proj, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), p AS (SELECT g.proj, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgcnt FROM p), k AS (SELECT p.cnt, p.ratio, p.cnt - a.avgcnt AS diff FROM p JOIN a ON a.avgcnt IS NOT NULL WHERE p.cnt > a.avgcnt) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM k
